rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for help or assistance that makes something more effective.

example.english: This new feature is a big boost to efficiency.
example.traditional: 呢個新功能對提升效率好有幫助。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 san1 gung1 nang4 deoi3 tai4 sing1 haau6 leot6 hou2 jau5 bong1 zo6

rows.note: Use this when emphasizing a contributing force that promotes progress or improves results rather than ordinary personal help.

example.english: Government funding is an important boost for economic recovery.
example.traditional: 政府嘅資助係推動經濟復甦嘅重要助力。
example.jyutping: zing3 fu2 ge3 zi1 zo6 hai6 teoi1 dung6 ging1 zai3 fuk6 sou1 ge3 zung6 jiu3 zo6 lik6

rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice when boosting an amount, number, or chance of success.

example.english: We need to increase publicity so we can boost sales.
example.traditional: 我哋要增加宣傳，先可以令銷量上升。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 zang1 gaa1 syun1 cyun4 sin1 ho2 ji5 ling6 siu1 loeng6 soeng5 sing1

rows.note: Use this when boosting a level, quality, performance, or standard rather than simply increasing a quantity.

example.english: Learning more English can boost your work performance.
example.traditional: 學多啲英文可以提高你嘅工作表現。
example.jyutping: hok6 do1 di1 jing1 man4 ho2 ji5 tai4 gou1 nei5 ge3 gung1 zok3 biu2 jin6

rows.note: Use this when something boosts the growth or activity of a wider process, sector, or situation by stimulating it.

example.english: The new policy will boost the development of the whole industry.
example.traditional: 新政策會帶動成個行業發展。
example.jyutping: san1 zing3 caak3 wui5 daai3 dung6 seng4 go3 hong4 jip6 faat3 zin2

rows.note: Use this for the literal physical force pushing someone from behind or below, especially in technical or descriptive contexts.

example.english: A rocket's boost comes from the thrust of its engine.
example.traditional: 火箭升空靠嘅係噴射器嘅推力。
example.jyutping: fo2 zin3 sing1 hung1 kaau3 ge3 hai6 pan3 se6 hei3 ge3 teoi1 lik6

rows.note: Use this physical construction when helping someone climb by lifting or pushing them upward from below.

example.english: I’ll boost you up from below; hold on to the rope.
example.traditional: 我喺下面托你上去，你捉實條繩呀。
example.jyutping: ngo5 hai2 haa6 min6 tok3 nei5 soeng5 heoi3 nei5 zuk1 sat6 tiu4 sing4 aa3
